subject.title: fix(agents): extend thinking error recovery to body, detail, and responseBody carriers

question: Should OpenClaw recognize `body`, `detail`, and `responseBody` as supported thinking-recovery carriers without a demonstrated current producer for those shapes?
rationale: These generic fields broaden a session-repair fallback boundary; code inspection can establish that the implementation is narrow, but only maintainers can decide whether speculative wrapper compatibility belongs in the core recovery contract.

options.title: Require producer proof first
options.body: Rebase the patch and accept it only after identifying a real wrapper contract and showing redacted runtime recovery through at least one new carrier.

options.title: Accept bounded compatibility
options.body: Land the string-only expansion based on the specific thinking-error pattern and existing positive and negative regression coverage.

options.title: Keep canonical carrier only
options.body: Close this PR and the linked issue if maintainers want recovery limited to the observed `ProviderHttpError.errorBody` contract.

recommendation.title: Require producer proof first
recommendation.body: Rebase the patch and accept it only after identifying a real wrapper contract and showing redacted runtime recovery through at least one new carrier.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history places the recovery wrapper and its stream-entry behavior in this person's area of direct contribution and merge review.
